name: Combo: Bars + Line
summary: Columns with a line on a secondary axis — e.g. revenue bars with the EBITDA margin line in % — with hatched estimate years and CAGR brackets.
summary_zh: 柱状 + 折线双轴组合图：如收入柱 + EBITDA 利润率折线（右轴 %），预测年份斜线填充，可加 CAGR 箭头标注。
description_zh: 投行财务概览页最常用的图：柱子表示规模（收入、EBITDA、FCF，可分组或堆叠），折线表示比率（利润率、增速）并使用右侧百分比轴。默认 band 布局把折线放在柱子上方的独立区域，数值标签互不遮挡；预测年份（period = E 或 x 以 E 结尾）自动以浅色斜线填充并加“Projected”底色区分。cagr 可在首尾柱之间画出括号箭头并标注复合增长率，'split' 同时标注历史与预测两段。适合 5–12 个年度/季度的时间序列。
best_for: Historical vs. projected growth with CAGR call-outs
Quarterly actual vs. consensus with margin overlay
Any magnitude + ratio pair over 5–12 periods
avoid_when: More than ~16 periods (use a line chart with zoom)
Two magnitudes in the same unit (use grouped bars)
Ratios that need their own precise scale reading (use separate charts)

bars.desc: Bar field(s): array = one bar series per field (wide); single field + series = long format

series.desc: Long-format bar series field (one bar series per distinct value; rows are summed)

line.desc: Line field(s) on the secondary axis (duplicate rows per x are averaged)

period.desc: Actual / estimate flag (values starting with E, F, P or B mark estimates) used by forecastFrom 'auto'

layout.desc: band = line in its own band above the bars (no label collisions) | overlay = classic dual axes with aligned ticks

barStack.desc: Stack the bar series (totals labelled on top)

labels.desc: Value labels: true | false | 'auto' (on when bars are wide enough) | 'bars' | 'line'

format.desc: Bar value format; defaults to the first bar field's format

lineFormat.desc: Line value format; defaults to the first line field's format (else 0.0%)

lineAxisFormat.desc: Right-axis tick format; defaults to lineFormat with redundant decimals trimmed

forecastFrom.desc: x value where estimates start; 'auto' = period field or x ending in E/F/B; null = no estimate styling

forecastLabel.desc: Caption above the estimate band ('' hides it)

cagr.desc: true = first→last bar; 'split' = actuals and estimates separately; {from, to, label, field} or an array of them

legend.desc: Top-left legend (shown when there is more than one series)

zoom.desc: Enable dataZoom on the period axis: slider + drag, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch (options.wheelZoom: true for the plain wheel)

interactions: Axis tooltip with every bar and line value (estimate periods flagged)
Click a bar to cross-filter on the period
Optional zoom (slider, drag, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch)
